CustomField.description: TRUE when the account is a referral partner. Aligned with Odoo boolean column. Decoupled from record type - an account can be both a customer and a referral partner.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when this account refers business to DE. Referral partners may or may not be customers themselves. Aligned with Odoo Referral Partner flag.
CustomField.label: Referral Partner
